why: Placeholders the template leaves to the user: Save to Sheet's documentId (YOURDOCUMENT_URL), filled with the fixture's sheet; and the Pexels Authorization header (YOUR_PEXELS_API_KEY), filled with a dummy key. The WordPress credential URL comes from the fixture's routes (bench credential). The prompt's '(YOUR PROMPT)' lines stay as written. Placeholder fills only: no logic changes. See timeCompression.

timeCompression.why: Processing Delay draws a random delay of up to 6 hours (Math.random) and Random Wait waits it, past the bench's timeout; the drawn value also differs per side. Random Wait is set to 1 second on both sides. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the delay is used by nothing else. Not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
